title: Product Map: status filter
description: User story under REQ-170. a reviewer preparing a sign-off pass a status filter (all, draft, review, needsRevision, approved, superseded) on the Product Map tab that applies to whichever grouping is active
asA: a reviewer preparing a sign-off pass
iWant: a status filter (all, draft, review, needsRevision, approved, superseded) on the Product Map tab that applies to whichever grouping is active
soThat: I can narrow the tab to just the "approved" or just the "needsRevision" REQs without switching tabs or scanning by hand

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Product Map tab carries a status filter control whose options are the five authoring statuses plus "all", and applies to every grouping on the tab. When "approved" is selected the tab renders only REQs whose status is approved. Buckets that become empty under the current filter are hidden by default with a summary line ("N empty" - clicking reveals them), so the map keeps its shape without rendering a wall of empty headings.
